assistant_sampled_frame_observation.case2: Visible forearm crossing and opening, bent-arm raises and small torso/stance changes; feet partly outside the crop. Some hands are motion-blurred in sampled frames.
assistant_sampled_frame_observation.case3: Visible wider and narrower stance changes, knee/torso lowering and rising, lateral weight changes and arm swings; several sampled face/hand regions are blurred during movement.
assistant_sampled_frame_observation.limitations: Only sampled images were viewed. No continuous audiovisual human score, music synchronization, or overall quality acceptance is claimed. Appearance observations are quality checks, not music-only target labels.
